appDescription: JEGAP keeps the car's resale value: it reads battery health and driving and charging habits, protects the car automatically (charge limit, windows, lights), and keeps a verified vehicle passport for trade-in.

function.name: GET_CAR_VALUE
function.description: Returns the car's current estimated resale value and how much value the driver's habits protected this month.

function.name: GET_BATTERY_HEALTH
function.description: Returns the EV battery state of health reported by the car and the charging habits that affect it.

function.name: SET_CHARGE_LIMIT
function.description: Sets the EV charging limit to protect the battery, for example 80 percent for daily driving or 100 percent before a long trip.

function.name: FIND_SERVICE_CENTER
function.description: Opens navigation search for the nearest authorized service center when a warning lamp or maintenance item needs attention.

function.name: GET_TRADE_IN_QUOTE
function.description: Returns a trade-in price estimate based on the verified vehicle passport, only while parked.
